text.en:
The articles specifically listed in Annexes "A" and "B"
hercof, as classified under Section 104 of the Tariff and Customs Code of
1978, as amended, shall be subject to the rates of import duty in
accordance with the schedule indicated opposite cach article.

The nomenclature and the rates of import duty on tariff
headings not enumerated in such annexes and those listed but
represented by the symbol "XXX" shall remain in force and effcct.

Upon the effectivity of this Executive Order, the articles
specifically listed in the aforesaid Annexes "A" and "B" which are entered
in or withdrawn from warchouses in the Philippines for consumption
shall be levied the rates of duty herein prescribed.

All other Presidential issuances, administrative rules and
regulations, or parts thercof, which arc inconsistent with this Exccutive
Order are hereby revoked or modified accordingly.
PGMA Outgolng #0 1 949

2

Annex "A" of this Executive Order shall take effect retroactive
01 January 2001 while Annex "B" shall take effect immediately following its
complete publication in two (2) newspapers of general circulation in the
*Philippines.
Done in the City of Manila, this 17th day of April, in the year of Our
Lord, two thousand and one.
By the President:
RENATO S DE VILLA
Executive Secretary
